items.title_zh: 观看：哈迪普·辛格·普里与德里大学的老朋友重聚，视频融化了人们的心
items.title_en: Watch: Hardeep Singh Puri reunites with old friend from Delhi University, video melts hearts
items.summary_zh: 联邦部长哈迪普·辛格·普里 (Hardeep Singh Puri) 在 2024 年共和国峰会上与来自德里大学的老朋友 DU Raj Dutta Ji 重聚。他们重聚的温馨视频，回忆大学记忆，开玩笑年龄，最后以一个温暖的拥抱结束，很快在社交媒体上疯传。
items.summary_en: Union Minister Hardeep Singh Puri reunites with his old friend, DU Raj Dutta Ji, from Delhi University at the Republic Summit 2024. The heartwarming video of their reunion, reminiscing about college memories, joking about ages, and ending with a warm hug, quickly went viral on social media.

items.title_zh: 铁路局：二婚不离婚意味着铁路员工没有养老金
items.title_en: Second Marriage Without Divorce Means No Pension For Railway Employees: Board
items.summary_zh: 未经许可多次结婚的政府工作人员可能会发现，只有他们的第一任妻子领取养老金。
items.summary_en: Government workers who marry several times without permission may find that only their first wife receives pension benefits.

items.title_zh: 观看：挖掘地球的人们发现数十只正在冬眠的海龟
items.title_en: Watch: Men Digging Earth Find Dozens Of Turtles Hibernating
items.summary_zh: 在视频中，包围海龟身体的壳是唯一可见的部分，使它们看起来像一个大有机体。
items.summary_en: In the video, the shells enclosing the bodies of the turtles are the only visible part, making them look like one big organism.
